rundown: Tunisia beat Poland 22-7 at Terrain de Rugby El Menzah. Tunisia led 22-0 at the half and never looked back.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 24, 8:58 AM ET. It had Poland 40% and Tunisia 60%, projecting Poland 23.4 – Tunisia 27.5 (50.9 total, Tunisia by 4.2).

Final: Poland 7 – Tunisia 22. Right winner: it had Tunisia at 60%.

Thin data: 0 of 6 key inputs were sourced (missing: POL pts scored, POL pts allowed, POL lineup rating or past seasons, TUN pts scored, TUN pts allowed, TUN lineup rating or past seasons), so league averages filled the gaps. It was logged as a no-data call: graded and learned from, never offered as a bet.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Poland came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 6 and 6 games of evidence. Projected to score 23.4, they scored 7 (−16.4 points, 70% under); projected to allow 27.5, they allowed 22 (−5.5 points, 20% under).

Tunisia came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 6 and 6 games of evidence. Projected to score 27.5, they scored 22 (−5.5 points, 20% under); projected to allow 23.4, they allowed 7 (−16.4 points, 70% under).

The bigger miss was Poland's scoring (-16.4 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 29 against 50.9 projected (-21.9), about the 7th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15).

Margin: Tunisia by 15 against Tunisia by 4.2 projected, about the 75th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±16).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Form (POL 5-0 L5 · TUN 2-1 L5): Tunisia ×1.01, Poland ×1.05. It favored Poland, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: inputs were missing (POL pts scored, POL pts allowed, POL lineup rating or past seasons, TUN pts scored, TUN pts allowed, TUN lineup rating or past seasons); there were no odds to check the projection against.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.564 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +12 points. It counts toward Rugby scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 27 graded Rugby games the algo now scales scoring ×0.976 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
